skill.name: korean-patent-search
skill.description: Search Korean patent and utility-model publications through the official KIPRIS Plus Open API with keyword search plus application-number detail lookup.
skill.summary: Find Korean patent publications by keyword and retrieve bibliographic details by application number.
skill.author: nomadamas

security_audit.summary: Twenty static findings are false positives involving credential names, ordinary HTTPS access, Markdown delimiters, version strings, error messages, and readable Korean documentation. Three command examples create supply-chain or scope risks through unattended npm execution and broad skill updates. No evidence found of credential theft, malicious prompt injection, or obfuscated executable content in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md instructs unattended execution of a mutable npm package for instructions and file listings.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer the reviewed local instructions and helper. Otherwise, pin a reviewed exact package version, verify integrity, and obtain approval before external execution.

remediation.issue: The recommended update command affects the CLI and unrelated coding-agent skill installations.
remediation.suggestion: Remove blanket updates from this search workflow. Offer narrowly scoped updates only after explicit approval and a clear description of affected installations.

content.user_title: Search Korean Patents with KIPRIS Plus
content.value_statement: Korean patent research requires consistent access to publication records and bibliographic details. This skill queries KIPRIS Plus and organizes keyword results or application-number details.
actual_capabilities: Search Korean patent and utility-model publications using the KIPRIS Plus getWordSearch operation.
Retrieve bibliographic details by application number using getBibliographyDetailInfoSearch.
Apply a year filter, select a result page, and configure the number of rows.
Include or exclude patents and utility models, while requiring at least one enabled type.
Extract available titles, applicants, abstracts, IPC classifications, publication metadata, registration status, and drawing URLs.
Convert XML responses into structured JSON using the bundled Python helper, with configurable request timeouts.
limitations: Requires internet access, Python 3, and a valid KIPRIS Plus ServiceKey; the documented npm workflow also requires Node.js.
Supports only keyword search and application-number bibliographic lookup, not full-text document downloads or legal opinions.
Returned fields can be missing, and available results depend on API coverage, access permissions, and service availability.
The documented CLI uses a mutable npm package selector and recommends broad updates; review execution and update scope before approval.

use_cases.title: Review related inventions
use_cases.description: Search a technical keyword and inspect titles, abstracts, and IPC classifications to identify records for further review.

use_cases.title: Check an application record
use_cases.description: Look up a known application number and organize the returned applicant, publication, registration, and date fields.

use_cases.title: Prepare a technical literature shortlist
use_cases.description: Filter keyword results by year and publication type, then compare available abstracts and applicants.

prompt_templates.title: Start a keyword search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search KIPRIS Plus for Korean patents about [keyword]. Show the first five results with application numbers, titles, and applicants.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: retrieve a small first page.

prompt_templates.title: Filter publication types
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [keyword] in [year], excluding utility models. Return ten records with titles, application dates, applicants, and abstracts when available.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect application details
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve KIPRIS Plus bibliographic details for application number [number]. Separate application, publication, and registration fields, and mark missing values.

prompt_templates.title: Build a traceable shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [keyword] for [year], using two pages of ten records. Compare applicants and IPC classifications, retaining application numbers and marking missing fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare paginated results without implying exhaustive coverage.

output_examples.input: Search for battery patents and show five results with applicants and abstracts.
output: Illustrative format only; this example contains no live search results.
Search summary: keyword, current page, requested rows, and total count reported by KIPRIS Plus.
Each record: application number, invention title, applicant, application date, and abstract.
Unavailable fields: marked as not provided by the API.

output_examples.input: Run a patent search without configuring a ServiceKey.
output_examples.output: Missing KIPRIS_PLUS_API_KEY. Configure the ServiceKey securely in the environment before retrying. No patent results were retrieved.

best_practices: Provide credentials through a secure environment, and keep keys out of chat, shell arguments, and shared logs.
Review the CLI version and update scope before execution; prefer reviewed local instructions and helper files where possible.
Retain application numbers, distinguish publication and registration dates, and verify important conclusions against official records.
anti_patterns: Treating an empty or limited keyword search as proof that no relevant patents exist.
Interpreting a returned status or abstract as a legal opinion on validity or freedom to operate.
Running blanket skill updates or unreviewed npm package versions as an automatic prerequisite to patent research.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools. Actual searches require the configured API credentials and runtime.

faq.question: Do I need a KIPRIS Plus API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure a valid ServiceKey through KIPRIS_PLUS_API_KEY. Avoid entering credentials in chat or shell arguments.

faq.question: Can I search both patents and utility models?
faq.answer: Yes. Keyword search enables both by default. You can exclude either type, but at least one must remain enabled.

faq.question: What search filters are implemented?
faq.answer: The helper supports a keyword, year, page number, row count, and patent or utility-model inclusion. Application-number lookup is a separate mode.

faq.question: Does the skill download complete patent documents?
faq.answer: No. It returns bibliographic fields, available abstracts, and drawing URLs from two API operations. It does not implement full-document downloads.

faq.question: What should I review before using the CLI?
faq.answer: The examples run a mutable npm package without an interactive confirmation. Review the package version and avoid unrelated installation updates.
